tier_reason: Orchestrator consistency retier: the only numbers come from a Momento blog, and Momento sells a managed Valkey service, so the source is a vendor, not an independent suite or peer-reviewed paper. Same rule as other vendor-blog evidence in waves 5-6: tier C.

corrections.caveats: Evidence is a blog by Momento, a vendor selling hosted Valkey (not independent).

tier_reason: Orchestrator retier after enrichment: the published CSVs (2023) were produced by code with two correctness bugs fixed in PR #1 (2024-07): the Patterned mask index was ANDed with an uninitialized variable and Blocked Query read the first 32 B instead of the key's block. The fixed code was never re-benchmarked, so the timed code is not the code a user would ship; the numbers remain real measurements but of buggy code.

corrections.caveats: Published numbers predate the PR #1 correctness fixes and were never re-run; CSVs show 19-20x (8.8-10.3x at 67M keys), not the blog's 22x.
